purpose: Teach: 見送る/盗む/つど/痛快/くどい/本末転倒/滴/モニカ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様を、本気で、絶対、見送る時の、絶対、笑顔、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、素敵と思うわ
lines.en: Aoi, the way you see off customers with such genuine warmth—I really think it's beautiful.
lines.style: Soft admiration, genuine tone. Unhurried cadence. Tender gaze, like noticing something private about someone she cares for.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、お祖父さまの、絶対、レシピ、絶対、盗む、絶対、ように、絶対、覚えたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. I learned it from watching my grandfather, actually. The way he treated people.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. Voice settles inward. A small smile in the words—remembering. Slower pace on the name. Not explaining, just sharing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様、絶対、来店、絶対、つど、絶対、お話、絶対、楽しんでるよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Every time a customer comes in, you really do seem to enjoy talking with them. I admire that about you.
lines.style: Genuine praise, no flattery. Steady eye contact in the voice. Observant—she's noticed this pattern. Warm but not effusive.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店の、本気で、絶対、新メニュー、絶対、痛快、絶対、な、絶対、味、絶対、お客様に好評よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new menu items are doing really well. Customers love them.
lines.style: Lighter, almost bright. A small note of pride in 'doing well.' Conversational pace, like sharing good news. Not boasting—just pleased.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様の説明、絶対、くどい、絶対、と、絶対、思われない、絶対、よう、絶対、簡潔に、絶対、伝えてるよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: The way you explain things to customers—it's never tedious or overwhelming. You keep it clear and simple. I notice that.
lines.style: Thoughtful observation, not performative praise. Specific. Warm underneath. Slight pause before 'clear and simple,' like she's choosing the right words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、忙しすぎて、絶対、お客様の声を、絶対、聞かないのは、絶対、本末転倒、絶対、ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Being too busy to really listen to customers—that's not the point of it all, is it?
lines.style: Reflective, a little worried. Not accusatory. Turning inward, thinking aloud. Gentle question at the end—checking in on her own understanding.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の窓に、本気で、絶対、雨の、絶対、滴、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、お洒落と思うわ
lines.en: The raindrops on your shop window are so lovely.
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy. Slow pace. Like she's sharing something small and precious she noticed. Trailing voice at the end, tender.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お友達の、絶対、モニカ、絶対、さん、絶対、来店してくれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your friend Monica came by the shop, didn't she?
lines.style: Light, warm observation. Small lift at the end—like she's pleased to hear it. Natural conversational pace, no emphasis needed.
